1| package edge
2| 
3| // probe sends one liveness check to a site collector and records the
4| // round trip. The attempt deadline comes from the prober config; the
5| // retry window wraps attempts so a lossy hop distinguishes a slow
6| // site from a dead one.
7| func (p *Prober) probe(target string) result {
8| 	ctx, cancel := p.attemptContext()
9| 	defer cancel()
10| 	start := p.clock.Now()
11| 	err := p.dial(ctx, target)
12| 	return result{
13| 		target:  target,
14| 		rtt:     p.clock.Now().Sub(start),
15| 		healthy: err == nil,
16| 	}
17| }

overview: uplink.go folds probe windows into a per-site health state with hysteresis in both directions and drops out-of-order windows loudly instead of rewinding.

1| package edge
2| 
3| import (
4| 	"sync"
5| 	"time"
6| )
7| 
8| // uplink tracks the health of a site's path to the core tier. State
9| // transitions are hysteretic: a link marks degraded after consecutive
10| // failed windows and recovers only after consecutive clean ones, so a
11| // single lossy window cannot flap the shipping path.
12| type uplink struct {
13| 	mu        sync.Mutex
14| 	degraded  bool
15| 	failRuns  int
16| 	cleanRuns int
17| 	last      time.Time
18| }
19| 
20| // observe folds one probe window into the health state. Callers pass
21| // windows in order; out-of-order windows are dropped with a counter
22| // rather than rewinding state, because replaying old windows would
23| // mask a live degradation.
24| func (u *uplink) observe(w window) {
25| 	u.mu.Lock()
26| 	defer u.mu.Unlock()
27| 	if w.start.Before(u.last) {
28| 		u.metricsOutOfOrder.Inc()
29| 		return
30| 	}
31| 	u.last = w.start
32| 	if w.clean() {
33| 		u.cleanRuns++
34| 		u.failRuns = 0
35| 	} else {
36| 		u.failRuns++
37| 		u.cleanRuns = 0
38| 	}
39| 	u.transition()
40| }
